jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, United States
jobs.description:
Tigera—the pioneer behind Calico and Lynx—is defining the future of AI agent security, workload governance, and cloud-native networking. As autonomous AI agents, LLM frameworks, and microservices proliferate across enterprise infrastructure, Tigera delivers the deep visibility, runtime protection, and eBPF-driven enforcement control required to secure the next generation of computing.

From modern cloud-native architectures to cutting-edge AI agent ecosystems, our technology safeguards over 1 million Kubernetes clusters across multicloud and hybrid environments. Trusted by world-class innovation leaders—including NVIDIA, Royal Bank of Canada, Bloomberg, Chipotle, GoDaddy, and Upwork—we empower enterprises to build, scale, and innovate with AI safely and without compromise.

At Tigera, our customers are the heroes of our story. We aim high, move fast, foster continuous learning, and build a high-trust, highly collaborative environment where every voice shapes the future of AI security. If you are looking to help make a substantial impact, and our values and products align with your vision of your career growth, we want to hear from you!

About Your Role

A once-in-a-decade shift is reshaping enterprise infrastructure. Nearly every enterprise is moving toward a single, self-hosted platform that can run both containers and virtual machines — to raise hardware utilization, cut costs, and simplify operations. Steep price hikes from legacy virtualization vendors are accelerating the shift, pushing organizations to migrate their VM estates onto Kubernetes at speed — each move carrying unique and complex networking requirements.

At the same time, enterprises are taking AI applications and AI agents from pilot to production , and increasingly hosting their own open LLMs to control token costs and keep models close to the proprietary data that lives in their data centers. It all converges on one requirement: a single platform that can host containers and VMs together — spanning data centers and regions, with enterprise-grade HA and DR, high performance, low latency, and massive scale.

The networking that makes these converged platforms work is extraordinarily complex and almost always on the critical path . Tigera has built the best-in-class networking solution for this new generation of converged platforms — and this role sits at the center of that opportunity.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own a set of high-impact, strategic initiatives across Tigera's product portfolio. This is a senior, high-ownership role spanning strategy through execution: for each initiative you take on, you will define product vision, shape go-to-market, and partner directly with engineering, sales, marketing, and ecosystem partners to bring new capabilities to market.

Your work will span the portfolio — from extending Calico's converged networking for VM workloads in Kubernetes , to newer products such as Lynx , to emerging AI- and agent-focused initiatives. Your first focus area will be matched to your strengths and our priorities, and the mix will evolve as the business grows — so this is a role for a product leader who wants range, not a single lane.

For this position, we are looking to hire in the San Francisco Bay Area (US), hybrid at our San Francisco or San Jose office.

San Francisco Bay Area Salary Range: $220,000 - $240,000 OTE

You Will Own:

- Product vision & roadmap for major initiatives across the portfolio — Calico, Lynx, and emerging AI-focused products — from MVP to GA and the phased roadmap that follows, sequenced by customer value and revenue impact.

- Competitive positioning in the Kubernetes networking and security market. You will craft differentiated narratives that lead with platform value — unified networking, best-in-class microsegmentation and DNS policy, cluster-mesh, observability — rather than competing feature-for-feature at the dataplane layer.

- Go-to-market strategy across both sales-led motions (sales enablement, crisp platform pitches, close partnership with sales on qualified opportunities) and partner-led motions with the ecosystem of platform and infrastructure partners.

- Customer discovery & validation with enterprise accounts — running structured interviews to pressure-test and falsify assumptions before committing engineering resources.

- Cross-functional execution with engineering on scope and delivery, and with marketing on messaging discipline and campaigns that shape market perception.

- Messaging & positioning discipline — building canonical positioning artifacts and driving consistency in how the product is described across the organization, to customers, and in market.

You Have:

- 8+ years in product management , including senior/principal-level ownership of technical infrastructure products, with a track record of taking products from vision to GA and revenue.

- Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native networking/security expertise — CNI, network policy, microsegmentation, L2/L3 networking concepts, eBPF, and the broader cloud-native ecosystem.

- Sharp competitive and positioning instincts — able to build canonical positioning artifacts (single-line description, problem/audience, category framing, differentiators, explicit "what it is not" boundaries) and enforce messaging consistency across the org.

- Enterprise GTM range — comfortable enabling sales, engaging senior technical buyers at large enterprises, and driving partner co-selling.

- Discovery-driven and evidence-based — you pressure-test assumptions with customer interviews and prioritize by revenue impact rather than work type.

- Crisp communicator and operator — structured, low-friction, and factually disciplined; you move quickly from insight to a decision-ready artifact.

Why This Role Matters:

Calico sits at the center of how modern enterprises connect and secure their infrastructure. As a Principal Product Manager, you will own strategic bets that shape the platform's direction and reframe how the market thinks about Calico — working directly with company leadership on some of Tigera's most consequential decisions.

With offices in San Francisco, San Jose, Vancouver (Canada), Cork (Ireland), and London (England), we have a thriving team of diverse individuals from all over the world. We believe in a collaborative, flexible work environment based on respect for, and commitment from, every employee. We also offer a competitive compensation package along with full health, vision, and dental benefits. These benefits, coupled with an amazing team of individuals who believe in our mission and value openness, collaboration, and teamwork, make Tigera an awesome place to work.
